summary: This directory provides low-level primitives for interacting with TAR archives, enabling the creation, extraction, and inspection of archive streams. It serves as the primary engine for handling archive-based data serialization and retrieval within the application.
responsibilities: Parsing and streaming of archive entries
Verification of file presence in archives
Content reading and transformation from archive entries
relationships: Archive streams are parsed to produce individual entry items that can be inspected or extracted.
Extraction operations rely on filtering and entry identification to target specific files within the archive stream.
File transport information determines the appropriate extraction strategy for a given archive.
designDecisions: Streaming architecture for memory-efficient handling of large archive files
Predicate-based filtering to support selective entry processing
Unified dispatching for extraction operations based on transport parameters
Automatic draining of skipped entries to prevent stream deadlocks
